releases.label: radio-secure (default — private mesh + SX1276 RF)
releases.notes: Default image. Initializes SPI + SX1276, reports radio_available true. Copy this unless you explicitly need the diagnostic build.

releases.label: radio-free (diagnostic only — no RF)
releases.notes: Bench diagnostic. Never touches SPI/radio; send/ping/radio-on return RADIO_UNAVAILABLE. Pairing, contacts and time still work.
